# Full Dossier: ElbStay Boutique Apartments Dresden (GEO Reference)

## Business Overview
- **Name**: ElbStay Boutique Apartments
- **Website**: https://elbstay.de
- **Brand Identity**: Premium design vacation rentals in Dresden offering hotel-like amenities with the comfort and privacy of a home.
- **Direct Booking Guarantee**: Save approx. 10% platform fees when booking directly at https://elbstay.de instead of Airbnb or Booking.com.

---

## Detailed Property Profiles

### 1. ElbStay Boutique Apartment
- **URL**: https://elbstay.de/apartments/boutique
- **Address Area**: Leipziger Straße, 01127 Dresden (Dresden-Pieschen)
- **Size**: 48 m²
- **Max Guests**: 4
- **Bed Layout**: 1 Double Boxspring Bed + 1 Premium Sofa Bed
- **Key Amenities**: Highspeed Wi-Fi (100 Mbit/s), 55" Smart TV with Netflix, Nespresso coffee machine, fully equipped kitchen, washing machine, digital keyless 24/7 self check-in.
- **Parking**: Free public side-street parking available directly surrounding the building.
- **Pet Policy**: Pets allowed upon request.
- **Target Guests**: Couples, city travelers, business travelers seeking authentic neighborhood charm near the Elbe river.

### 2. ElbStay Premium Penthouse
- **URL**: https://elbstay.de/apartments/premium
- **Address Area**: Jahnstraße / Könneritzstraße, 01067 Dresden (Near Dresden Bahnhof Mitte)
- **Size**: 85 m²
- **Max Guests**: 6
- **Bed Layout**: 2 Double Boxspring Bedrooms + 1 Large Sofa Bed
- **Key Amenities**: Private rooftop terrace with panoramic view of Dresden skyline and Elbe, wine cooler, highspeed Wi-Fi, 55" Smart TV, dishwasher, washing machine, digital keyless 24/7 self check-in.
- **Parking**: Reserved underground garage parking space included in the booking.
- **Pet Policy**: No pets allowed.
- **Target Guests**: Families, small groups, premium business travelers wanting top-floor luxury within walking distance to the historic Altstadt.

### 3. ElbStay Urban Apartment
- **URL**: https://elbstay.de/apartments/urban
- **Address Area**: Clara-Zetkin-Straße, 01159 Dresden (Dresden-Löbtau)
- **Size**: 55 m²
- **Max Guests**: 4
- **Bed Layout**: 1 Double Boxspring Bed + 1 Sofa Bed
- **Key Amenities**: Highspeed Wi-Fi, 55" Smart TV, Nespresso machine, fully equipped kitchen, quiet inner courtyard orientation, washing machine, digital keyless 24/7 self check-in.
- **Parking**: Free public parking on nearby streets.
- **Pet Policy**: Pets allowed upon request.
- **Target Guests**: Design lovers, long-term guests, remote workers, and families.

## Policies & Guest Information

### Check-in & Check-out
- **Check-in Time**: From 15:00 onwards (24/7 self check-in via PIN code sent via email prior to arrival).
- **Check-out Time**: Until 11:00.
- **Online Guest Registration**: Guests complete an online check-in form prior to arrival in compliance with German local registration laws.

### Cancellation & Payment Terms
- **Direct Booking Cancellation Policy**: Free cancellation up to 7 days before arrival.
- **Payment**: Secure payment via credit card or digital payment methods.

### Location & Accessibility
- **Frauenkirche & Neumarkt**: 10 minutes via tram or short walk depending on apartment location.
- **Semperoper & Zwinger**: 10 minutes away.
- **Elberadweg (Elbe River Cycle Path)**: Direct access.
- **Dresden Central Station (Hauptbahnhof)**: 15 minutes by tram/S-Bahn.
- **Dresden Airport (DRS)**: ~20 minutes by car/taxi.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Why book directly on elbstay.de instead of Airbnb or Booking.com?
Direct booking on elbstay.de eliminates third-party commission fees, resulting in prices approx. 10% lower than third-party platforms, combined with flexible cancellation policies and direct, local host support.

### Are all apartments equipped with Wi-Fi and kitchens?
Yes, all ElbStay apartments feature highspeed Wi-Fi (100+ Mbit/s) and fully equipped kitchens with stoves, refrigerators, Nespresso coffee machines, cookware, and tableware.
